popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Zeus hides Elara under the earth for fear of Hera; there she bears the giant Tityus — the Orchomenian mother of the earth-reared offender against Leto.

popCulture.title: Elara (mythology)
popCulture.description: Daughter of Orchomenus (or Minyas) and mother of Tityus by Zeus — mortal princess whose womb the earth itself was said to finish.
